instruction: A grand old library hall: towering bookshelves with ladders on brass rails, long reading desks with green banker's lamps, a large globe, a spiral staircase to a railed mezzanine, and arched windows letting in slanted evening light. user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Old Library Hall. A grand old library hall: towering bookshelves with ladders on brass rails, long reading desks with green banker's lamps, a large globe, a spiral staircase to a railed mezzanine, and arched windows letting in slanted evening light. Piles of books, an open atlas, and drifting dust motes complete the hushed scholarly atmosphere. Style: dark academia. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
